CustomField.description: DeveloperName (API name) of the Salesforce Public Group whose members can conduct mock interviews for this program. Populated via a dropdown in the Program Creation flow (queries all Regular Public Groups at runtime). If blank, the portal falls back to a default group name. Enables different programs to use different interviewer pools -- e.g. AI_ML_Mock_Interviewers, Resume_Mock_Interviewers.
CustomField.label: Mock Interviewer Public Group
